HTTP redirects now fail through the existing non-2xx error contract with redirect:manual; actual HTTP307/308 same-origin and cross-port regressions prove no command/capability forwarding, while direct authenticated POST behavior is retained.
Captured output is read through one nonblocking no-follow descriptor with fstat regular-file check and bounded buffer.
